stats.notes: IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2023 first-time students): 9,889 applicants, 8,594 admitted, 2,156 enrolled; international (nonresident alien) first-time applicants 24, admitted 20, enrolled 9, so the international sample is very small. College Navigator fall 2024: 9,246 applicants, 87% admitted. UNO reports ACT only (no SAT percentiles). Undergraduate enrollment 11,756 and 15:1 ratio are fall 2024; nonresidents are about 3% of undergraduates (rounded). No readable Common Data Set was found for this college, so the figures come from IPEDS; GPA, residency and class-rank details are not included.

cost.notes: College Navigator 2024-25: tuition and fees in-state $8,718, out-of-state $23,206; on-campus food and housing $12,130, other $4,032; the total cost of attendance shown is the out-of-state on-campus total
